_comment: Example concurrent workload: process 2 minutes of capture within a 3-minute (180s) deadline. All three models are in our benchmark set, so they are predicted directly (no proxy / fixed latency needed). Run: make recommend-rps WORKLOAD=examples/workload_3min.json BUDGET=250000

streams.name: yolo11l
streams._note: 16 tiles x 25 fps x 120 s = 48000 frames @ 640x640 tiles (heavy detector, dominates GPU-seconds)

streams.name: rtdetr-l
streams._note: every 8th frame -> 500 frames @ 640x640 (RT-DETR transformer detector, not a YOLO)
